eventDetail.scope: This conference will explore strategic engineering management, cyber-physical convergence, and intelligent system deployment using cutting-edge technologies such as AI/ML, cloud/edge computing, blockchain, and quantum computing. It integrates sustainability, security, and talent management as key enablers for deploying solutions in healthcare, defence, aerospace, smart manufacturing, and Industry 5.0. The conference also embraces startups, digital innovation, and future-ready workforce strategies for responsible growth.
